subject: Matemática
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas de cálculo de medida de área de figuras planas que podem ser decompostas por quadrados, retângulos e/ou triângulos, utilizando a equivalência entre áreas.

components.description_pt: Decompor uma figura plana em quadrados, retângulos e/ou triângulos
components.description_en: Decompose a plane figure into squares, rectangles, and/or triangles
components.cc_component_description: Find area of polygons by composing into rectangles or decomposing into triangles and other shapes and use to solve mathematical problems

components.description_pt: Aplicar o princípio de equivalência de áreas em figuras planas compostas
components.description_en: Apply the principle of area equivalence to composite plane figures
components.cc_component_description: Determine the area of two-dimensional figures composed of various polygons in mathematical problems

components.description_pt: Determinar a área de figuras bidimensionais compostas por vários polígonos
components.description_en: Determine the area of two-dimensional figures composed of various polygons in mathematical problems
components.cc_component_description: Determine the area of two-dimensional figures composed of various polygons in mathematical problems

components.description_pt: Compor um problema envolvendo a área de uma figura decomposta em formas simples
components.description_en: Compose a problem involving the area of a figure decomposed into simpler shapes
components.cc_component_description: Determine the area of two-dimensional figures composed of various polygons in mathematical problems

cc_matches.description: Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving area, volume and surface area of two- and three-dimensional objects composed of triangles, quadrilaterals, polygons, cubes, and right prisms.

Find the area of right triangles, other triangles, special quadrilaterals, and polygons by composing into rectangles or decomposing into triangles and other shapes; apply these techniques in the context of solving real-world and mathematical problems.

prerequisites.description_pt: Estabelecer expressões de cálculo de área de triângulos e de quadriláteros.
Associar figuras espaciais a suas planificações (prismas, pirâmides, cilindros e cones) e analisar, nomear e comparar seus atributos.
